posts.text: 𝟏𝟎𝟎,𝟎𝟎𝟎 𝒈𝒂𝒏𝒈𝒘𝒂𝒚 𝒕𝒓𝒂𝒏𝒔𝒇𝒆𝒓𝒔 (LinkedIn i dag - 16.11.): https://www.linkedin.com/company/integrated-wind-solutions-asa/posts/ "Our Skywalker class CSOVs are equipped with motion-compensated gangways. These are walkways that cancel out the vessel’s movement in the waves, so technicians can walk safely from our vessel onto the wind turbine, even in harsh conditions🌊 This milestone means 100,000 safe walk-to-work transfers have been achieved without any incidents, made possible by our skilled crew and state-of-the-art vessels🚢 A proud milestone for everyone involved, celebrated both on- and offshore! On to the next 𝟭𝟬𝟬,𝟬𝟬𝟬🚀"
